title: Contentful CMA personal access token as a bare CFPAT- value, a bare 64-hexadecimal value, or beside redactedValue
summary: A bare CFPAT- value with 43 characters after the prefix, a bare CFPAT- value with 64, a bare 64-character lowercase hexadecimal value, and a response member holding only a four-character redactedValue.
rationale: Evidence on the personal access token shape points three ways and is era-dependent: provider placeholders and two rule artifacts begin CFPAT- (one fixes 43 characters after it, another allows 40 or more); the current API reference example shows 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters with no prefix (claim reference-example-token-shape-differs, unresolved); and a 2018 SDK recording lead has CFPAT- plus 64 (open question format-and-prefix-era). Contentful states no prefix, alphabet or length, and independence of the two artifacts is unconfirmed (cfpat-prefix-and-alphabet-consistency). The sys.redactedValue member is not described (redacted-value-member). No outcome is asserted for any bare shape.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Whether a bare CFPAT- value of 43 or 64 characters, a bare 64-character hexadecimal value, or a redactedValue member is or contains a Contentful personal access token is not stated by any Contentful page. Settled by a Contentful statement of the token format and its history, or a dated archive snapshot of the Authentication or Create an access token page.

sources.supports: Example 201 response with a token member that is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and a sys.redactedValue member of four characters (value not copied here).
